### 3-seed 对比 (no_trace condition)

| Seed | Accuracy |
|------|----------|
| seed42 | 75.13% |
| seed123 | 79.08% |
| seed456 | 75.04% |
| **Mean ± Std** | **76.42 ± 2.31%** |

seed456 与 seed42 接近，seed123 偏高。3-seed 标准差 2.31 个百分点，方差较大，主要由 seed123 拉高。
